info.title: Quizzly API
info.description:
The HTTP API behind the Quizzly app. The app reads its own rows straight from Supabase, but every
change goes through here, so ownership is always checked (FRD §2.16).

## Signing in

Every `/v1` route needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is the Supabase access
token of a signed-in student. To try routes here, click **Authorize** and paste one. You can get a
token from the app's session, or from Supabase directly:

```
curl -X POST "$SUPABASE_URL/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password" \
  -H "apikey: $SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "…"}'
```

## Errors

Errors are JSON: `{"detail": "a sentence the app can show as-is"}` (copy from FRD §4). Request
validation errors (422) send `detail` as a list instead, one entry per problem.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing, invalid or expired token. |
| 403 | The course or document was shared with the student, so only its owner can change it. |
| 404 | Not found, or not the student's: other people's things are never revealed. |
| 409 | Conflicts: a course code already used, a quiz not ready yet, an id already taken. |
| 410 | A share link that was stopped, replaced or taken down. |
| 422 | Invalid input, including text over its length limit. |
| 429 | Out of a daily allowance (`GET /v1/usage`), a shared course is full, or too many lookups. |

## Conventions

- Ids are UUIDs. Where the app creates something it may retry (quiz attempts), it chooses the id,
  so resending the same request is safe.
- Slow work (processing an upload, writing questions, marking) runs in the background worker; poll
  the resource's `GET` until its `status` changes.
- Each response carries an `x-request-id` header. Send your own to trace a request through logs.
- Shared-course members never receive storage URLs or other people's scores, chats or progress,
  and exam-mode quizzes include no answers until submitted.

get.description: Liveness check; doesn't need a token or the database.

Readiness check for deploys: the database answers. The deploy script rolls back when this
isn't 200 (503 when the API has no database).

The signed-in student's profile. The app keeps them in onboarding until it's complete
(FR-PROF-01).

delete.description:
Deletes the account and everything only this student owns (FR-AUTH-05, NDPA), including
the profile photo. Files Storage can't remove right now are retried by the worker, well within
the 24 h allowed.

patch.description:
Changes only the fields sent. A listed institution and a typed-in one are
alternatives: setting one clears the other. `accept_terms` records the current terms.

put.description:
Sets the profile photo (FR-PROF-04). The body is the cropped 512x512 WebP the app made
(`Content-Type: image/webp`, at most 300 KB). The server checks and re-encodes it, which
strips EXIF and GPS data, and names the file itself; the old photo is deleted.

delete.description: Removes the profile photo and deletes the file (FR-PROF-04). Initials show again.

get.description:
Searches institutions for onboarding in the student's country (FR-PROF-08): short names by
prefix ("UNILAG"), full names by substring or similarity.
The student's courses, then courses shared with them (FR-SHARE-05).

schema.title: Response List Courses V1 Courses Get

post.description:
Adds a course. A code the student already uses is a 409; the exam date must be
today or later (FR-CRS-04).

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. A course shared with the student is a 403 (FR-DOC-12).

delete.description:
FR-CRS-03: the app asks whether to delete the course's documents or move them to Unfiled.
A shared course stops being shared first, so members are told (FR-CRS-03).

get.description:
Outlines, written explanations and the student's quizzes for one of their courses, or a
course shared with them. Original files are never included (FR-SHARE-02).
The student's own past papers for this course; nobody else's, even in a shared course.

schema.title: Response Paper Styles V1 Courses  Course Id  Paper Styles Get

get.description:
Each allowance on the student's plan: used today, the daily amount, and what's left now.
Unused allowance saves up for a week (FR-LIM-01/08).

The documents the student can open. Filter with `course_id`, or `unfiled=true` for
those not in a course.

schema.title: Response List Documents V1 Documents Get

post.description: Registers an upload and returns signed URLs; the files go straight to Storage.
A fresh signed URL to retry an upload that didn't finish (FR-DOC-04).

The app calls this after its PUT succeeds; processing starts in the background. The files
must be in the document's own folder, in time, within size and really of their type
(FR-SEC-02). Otherwise the document stays waiting so the app can upload again.

get.description: One document, with its processing status; poll this while it's being processed.

patch.description:
Renames a document or moves it to another course (`course_id: null` for Unfiled).
Documents in a course shared with the student can't be changed (FR-DOC-12).

delete.description: Also gives back today's upload if the document was uploaded today.

get.description: The document's topics with the student's own renames, merges and splits applied.

put.description: Screen 27b: a name that makes sense to the student, for their eyes only.

post.description: Screen 27c: this topic and the next one become one, for this student only.
Undo a merge: back to the original topics.

get.description: Text of one page, for citation chips (FR-DOC-10).
The page as the student uploaded it, for the source viewer (FR-DOC-10).
Poll while an explanation is being written.

post.description:
Cached explanations come back at once and are free (FR-EXPL-04); otherwise one is
queued, using one of the student's daily explanations (FR-LIM-01).
Thumbs up/down (FR-MOD-03).
Wrong / unclear / inappropriate (FR-MOD-01).

A quiz on the chosen topics (all of them when none are given). The same choices reuse
a cached question set (FR-QGEN-07); otherwise today's allowance is used (429 when it's gone)
and the questions are written in the background, so poll `GET /v1/quizzes/{quiz_id}`.

A round of flashcards for one topic (FR-QGEN-10, screen 25): a cached set of front/back
cards, played as a practice-only quiz of kind "flashcards". Rating a card is its answer.

get.description: Poll while questions are being written; includes them once ready.

post.description:
Starts an attempt with an id the app chose, so a resent request doesn't start a
second one. 409 if the quiz isn't ready or the id is already used (FR-SEC-18).

put.description:
Saves answers as the student goes (idempotent; safe to resend after a dropped request).
In practice mode written answers are marked straight away; in exam mode after submitting.

post.description:
Saves any last answers, then scores the attempt; unanswered questions score zero. With
written answers still to mark it stays 'marking' until the worker has marked them.

get.description: The Practice tab: recent attempts (in-progress ones can be resumed) and weak topics.
One of the student's attempts, to resume it or show its results.
Everything Today shows, in one small payload (FR-HOME-01..05, NFR-02).
The study-days grid on screen 15 (FR-HAB-04).
Only the student's own achievements; anyone else's is a 404.

post.description: Marks celebrations as shown so they don't appear again.

get.description:
Today's 5 questions: due for review, then weak topics, then new (FR-HAB-01). Doesn't count
against the daily quiz limit: no questions are generated.

post.description: Batched reading time from explanation screens (FR-HAB-02).

schema.title: Response Reading V1 Events Reading Post

get.description: The week starting on Monday `week` (FR-HAB-06). The app draws the shareable image.
Weekly goal, theme, night and low-data modes, share permission, identity on links.

patch.description: Weekly goal, theme, night and low-data modes, share permission, identity on links.

get.description: Daily reminder and its time, quiet hours, and per-type toggles (FR-HAB-08).

patch.description: Daily reminder and its time, quiet hours, and per-type toggles (FR-HAB-08).

get.description:
Newest first, 30 at a time: `before` pages back; `after` fetches what Realtime may have
missed while the app was offline (FR-NOTIF-07).

post.description: Marks these notifications read; ids that aren't the student's are ignored (FR-NOTIF-05).
Marks every notification read.

Registers this device's Expo push token after sign-in. A token moves with its
device, so it now belongs to this account.

delete.description: Forgets this device's push token, e.g. on sign-out.

get.description: The owner's share link for this course; 404 when it isn't shared.

post.description: Makes the share link if needed and sends the course to people in Quizzly (FR-SHARE-01).
A new share link; the old one stops working. Members keep access (FR-SHARE-07).
Stops sharing the course; members lose access and are told.

get.description:
Who joined the owner's shared course: display names, and photos only where the student
chose to show theirs (FR-SHARE-07, FR-PROF-05).

schema.title: Response Members V1 Courses  Course Id  Members Get

delete.description: Removes someone from the owner's shared course.

post.description: FR-MOD-05: 5 different members unshare a course pending review.

get.description:
People who already share a course with the student, as quick picks on screen 19.
Blocked people never appear (FR-SHARE-09).
Screen 20 from a share link (FR-SHARE-04).

post.description: Add to library from a link.

get.description: Screen 20 for a course sent in Quizzly.

post.description: Add to library / Not now / Leave course (FR-SHARE-03, 07).

get.description: Privacy and blocking: the people you've blocked.

post.description: FR-SHARE-09: they can't send you courses or appear as a coursemate.

get.description: Screen 23.

post.description: The app showed the discount celebration (23c); it isn't shown again.

The app sends the code it kept through sign-up (FR-AUTH-07). Unknown codes are ignored,
so a bad link never blocks the new student.

get.description: Screen 32: Free, Student and Premium with their limits and prices (FR-PLAN-01).

post.description:
The app sends the Play purchase token after checkout. The plan is given only after Google
confirms the subscription, that it was bought for this account, and that the invite price was
unlocked (FR-PLAN-03).

get.description: The saved chat for this document; `thread_id` is null until the first question.

post.description:
Streams `token` events, then one `done` event with both stored messages (or `error`).
The pooled connection is released before streaming so a slow model can't hold it.

200.description: A Server-Sent Events stream: `token` events with `{text}`, then one `done` event with `{thread_id, question, answer}` (each a MessageOut), or one `error` event with `{detail}`.

429.description: Today's chat messages are used up.

delete.description: Starts over: deletes the thread and its messages.

CelebrationOut.title: CelebrationOut
CelebrationOut.description: Screen 16 (FR-HAB-05): one of the student's own achievements, ready to draw.

OfflineManifest.title: OfflineManifest
OfflineManifest.description: What "Save for offline" fetches, with sizes, so the size shows first (FR-OFF-03).

PaperStyleOut.title: PaperStyleOut
PaperStyleOut.description:
A past paper's style for quiz setup (FR-QGEN-09, screen 26b). Only its format, never its
questions.

HTTPBearer.description: A Supabase access token for the signed-in student (`session.access_token`).
